generation_inputs.preparation: Exact 32x nearest-neighbour enlargement of native 24x24 PNG, without recolouring or aspect correction.

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: faithful Historyline 1914–1918 original Amiga road-bridge terrain redraw study.
Input image: edit target, exact nearest-neighbour enlargement of 24x24 PARTS:SSTRE091. Repaint this particular sprite with minimal, restrained modern illustrated detail; at 24x24 it should look about 90% like the input.
Lock original composition, image coordinates and widths: the grey paved ROAD runs diagonally from the upper-left sloping edge to the lower-right sloping edge, with its exact sparse tiny white centre markings. Blue/teal WATER runs from the short top-centre edge to the short bottom-centre edge, crossing under the road. Preserve the reference's dark blue-grey water masses, few cyan highlights, tan shore/abutment patches, brown earth and olive/lime green grassy areas on left/right. The bridge is a flat grey road surface over this water, not an architectural arched bridge. Do not invent parapets, supports, railings, piers, arch, cast shadows, perspective, new shoreline or lane markings. Keep original bank positions and road intersections at the boundary exactly.
Fine grain/brushwork may be added INSIDE the original material shapes, at very low contrast: subtle pavement grain, sparse grass detail, slight water ripple texture. Match the original olive/midgreen colours and medium grey road; keep grass smooth and muted, water sparse, no bright yellow stippling or large new dark patches. Detail averages back to source colours when reduced to 24x24. Maintain all white dash positions and original orientation.
Output one square full-bleed tile with the source's stepped six-sided hex footprint: short top/bottom edges across middle third, pointed left/right sides at midheight. Fully opaque painted material inside the footprint, genuinely transparent outside. No alpha haze, frame, padding, outline, bevel, dark rim, text or labels. Newly illustrated high-resolution study, not an upscaled screenshot; preserve all landmarks and routes.
cleanup: Generated source retained without pixel edits. tools/art-review makes alpha-weighted area reductions and clips to exact original coverage. It caps alpha, preserves candidate holes and does not repair semi-transparent interiors. Intrinsic native density only; no display-aspect or world-spacing correction.
review: See docs/art/connected-terrain-pilot.md. Assistant review is preliminary; source geometry, opacity, palette/markings and eventual joins need cleanup. No 90/100 approval or runtime port mapping.
determinism: AI reruns are not assumed deterministic; exports reproduce locally from retained source using tools/art-review.
